item.title: Princeton Celebrates Anne Carson, a Nobel Prize Winner Who Was Denied Tenure

item.title: Spain’s Protesters See ‘Madness’ of Rising Rent and a ‘Martyr’ in Maricarmen

item.dc:creator: Carlos Barragán
item.media:credit: Oscar Del Pozo/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images
item.media:description: Protesters marched in memory of Maria del Carmen Abascal, who was widely known as Maricarmen, in Madrid on Thursday. Soaring rents have far outpaced wage growth in Spain, according to an analysis by the newspaper El País.
